etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: Borrowed from Late Latin plēthōra, from Ancient Greek πληθώρα (plēthṓra, “fullness, satiety”), from πλήθω (plḗthō, “to be full”) +‎ -η (-ē, nominal suffix).
senses: (usually followed by of) An excessive amount or number; an abundance.
(medicine) Excess of blood in the skin, especially in the face and especially chronically.
